differences.a_observable: Pronounced perspective distortion on the Recurly tile edges.
differences.b_observable: Flatter perspective with nearly parallel vertical edges.
differences.fix: Match the camera focal length and distance to the reference.

differences.a_observable: Distinct, soft contact shadows under the floating tiles.
differences.b_observable: Faint contact shadows, reducing the sense of depth.
differences.fix: Enable or strengthen ambient occlusion and contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: Visible vignette darkening the corners of the frame.
differences.b_observable: Uniform brightness across the frame with no vignette.
differences.fix: Add a subtle vignette in post-processing.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust camera focal length and strengthen contact shadows to restore depth.
